name: Lying Cable Leg Curl
steps: Set a cable pulley to the lowest position and attach an ankle strap or a short handle.
Lie face down on a flat bench with your feet toward the cable and secure the attachment around your ankles.
Hold the front of the bench or its handles and keep your hips pressed down and your legs straight.
Curl your heels toward your glutes by bending your knees, without lifting your hips off the bench.
Pause for a moment when your hamstrings are fully contracted.
Slowly straighten your legs back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
coaching_cues: Keep your hips flat on the bench
Control the weight on the way down
Do not swing the weight to start the curl
